goal.title: Target Tech Role
goal.description: The technical career role or goal you want to achieve (e.g. 'Machine Learning Engineer', 'Software Engineer', 'Data Scientist', 'AI Engineer').

currentLevel.title: Current Experience Level
currentLevel.description: Your current overall level in this technical domain.

knownSkills.title: Known Skills
knownSkills.description: List of skills, programming languages, or tools you already know well.

hoursPerWeek.title: Hours per Week
hoursPerWeek.description: Estimated hours per week dedicated to learning.

location.title: Location / Country
location.description: Learner's country/region for localized opportunity & hackathon matching.

interests.title: Niche & Domain Interests
interests.description: Specific subfields or domain applications of interest (e.g. ['NLP', 'healthcare AI']).

depth.title: Roadmap Depth
depth.description: Level of detail for the generated path.

geminiApiKey.title: Gemini API Key
geminiApiKey.description: Google Gemini API key for AI-driven skill dependency graph & assessment generation. Can also be set as GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable.

apifyToken.title: Apify API Token
apifyToken.description: Optional Apify API token for live web scraping & search discovery.
